Text: Welcome back, <NAME>.
Your report, please.

Yes ma’am.
The mirror of the Pandemonium Regalia has been safely recovered.
That makes all three Regalia recovered.
Excellent job, <NAME>.
Never doubted ya for a second, <NAME>!
Congratulations, <NAME>.
Well done, <NAME>.

You did it, !
Jean-Paul thinks you’re cool too!

Awesome, !
Way to go!
Knew ya could do it.
None
Good work...

You were amazing, .
Thank you for all your hard work.
You did great, <NAME>.

...
You’re fantastic... ♥

You did so good, !
You’re so wonderful! ♥
Thank you, <NAME>, for retrieving the Pandemonium Regalia for us.

You did it, !
Thanks for your hard work.

I knew you could do it, !
You’re the best!
Sincerely, thank you for everything, <NAME>.
Thank you. I was only able to do it thanks to all of you.
But...
What’s wrong?
There’s something that last demon said that’s still bothering me...
What, that thing about, “It doesn’t matter”?
You’re right...
Yuri, are there any unusual readings coming from below the Mikasa?
No, nothing at present.
I see...
Are you sure that demon wasn’t just being a sore loser?
I’d like to think so, but...
Well, there’s no use worrying about it right now.
We’ll just keep monitoring the area beneath the Mikasa.
<NAME>, thank you for everything you’ve done.
Go get plenty of rest.
